scope: Read-only product review; synthetic Node transport only; no production network, database, provider, wallet or deployment actions.

findings.summary: Response rejection classification is broader than inspected backend contract.
findings.evidence: Initial inspected diff classified arbitrary parsed 4xx as rejection. Candidate changed during review; all eight probes in this report executed the corrected classifier and returned unknown. New bounded suite also covers malformed/ambiguous responses.
findings.recommendation: Restrict rejection statuses/envelope to observed pre-write backend contract; require meaningful literal reason and no contradictory success/identity fields. Route other 4xx and contradictory envelopes to unknown. Add buy/sell regression cases.
findings.resolution: Known 400/403/429 require literal detail, false/absent ok and absent order identity. HTTP success ok:false requires expected literal reason and absent identity; contradictory or arbitrary status returns unknown.

coverageAssessment.matrix: Accurately distinguishes static site/bot claims from inert exact-handler execution and Mini App behavior; no whole-E4 acceptance claim.
coverageAssessment.lostResponse: Reproduced by existing 73 passing tests; inspected buy _order_store.create and sell _sell_store.create run before response, so lost response cannot prove absence. Fault fixtures do not establish actual backend persistence or production incidents.
coverageAssessment.browser: Runner inspected; routes every network request to synthetic/denied transport, native DOM and fetch used. Not independently executed in this review.
coverageAssessment.remaining: Real Telegram, WebKit, accessibility and human comprehension remain open; deferred wallet preparation/signature races remain separate.
coverageAssessment.boundary: Bounded unknown-outcome code fix justified. Corrected classifier closes initial review concern; no remaining blocker observed for this slice. Entire E4 remains open.
